module: Flowgraph node "Spawn Vehicle Group" (default category). Spawns a group of vehicles with core_multiSpawn.spawnGroup. Pins: group (without a group: default traffic group), quantity (-1 or nil: trafficAmount value from the game settings), shuffle, spawnMode (roadAhead, roadBehind, traffic, lineAhead, lineBehind, lineLeft, lineRight, lineAbove, raceGrid, raceGridAlt; default road), spawnGap (15), startPos, startRot, randomColors, dontDelete; reset deletes the created vehicles. Outputs: flow, loaded pulse, vehicleIds. The vehicles are added to the flowgraph vehicle module.
notes: The default of spawnMode ('road') is not in the list of offered modes (inferred from code).
State machine self.state: 0 waiting, 1 spawning in progress, 2 loaded, 3 finished.

onNodeReset.desc: Deletes the vehicles created by this node (scene and editor) then resets the state.

onVehicleGroupSpawned.desc: Hook called when a group has been created; if groupId matches, registers the vehicles, publishes vehicleIds and goes to state 2.

groupId.desc: identifier of the group created by core_multiSpawn

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the spawnMode pin.

resetState.desc: Resets state, groupId, id list and flow output.

work.desc: On the first flow, launches spawnGroup (or finishes directly if the quantity is 0), then emits loaded and lets the flow through once loaded.
